description: Ministry of Defence - Regulation of Private Security Agencies Act, No. 45 of 1998
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the Regulation of Private Security Agencies Act, No. 45 of 1998, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework. It amends fee structures and compliance requirements for private security agencies, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
